# Flat Elements Iterator Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Implement `Elements` and `ElementsMut` in `src/iter/elements.rs` so tensors can be traversed in logical F-order across contiguous, non-contiguous, empty, and rank-0 layouts.

**Architecture:** Two iterator structs share the same traversal policy. F-contiguous input uses pointer increment; non-contiguous input uses `StrideState`. Empty tensors yield zero items and rank-0 tensors yield exactly one element.

**Tech Stack:** Rust iterators, `ExactSizeIterator`, `StrideState`

**Design Docs:** `design/10-iterator.md` §5.1, §6.1, §6.4, §6.5.1, §7 T3; `design/07-tensor.md` §5.4, §5.4a; `design/00-coding.md` §6, §8

**Prerequisites:** W11T1 (`StrideState`) must be complete.

use core::marker::PhantomData;

use crate::dimension::Dimension;
use crate::tensor::{TensorView, TensorViewMut};

use super::StrideState;

enum IterMode<D: Dimension> {
    Empty,
    Contiguous { next: usize },
    Strided { state: StrideState<D> },
}

pub struct Elements<'a, A, D: Dimension> {
    ptr: *const A,
    shape: D,
    strides: D,
    remaining: usize,
    mode: IterMode<D>,
    marker: PhantomData<&'a A>,
}

pub struct ElementsMut<'a, A, D: Dimension> {
    ptr: *mut A,
    shape: D,
    strides: D,
    remaining: usize,
    mode: IterMode<D>,
    marker: PhantomData<&'a mut A>,
}

impl<'a, A, D> Elements<'a, A, D>
where
    D: Dimension + Clone,
{
    pub(crate) fn new(view: TensorView<'a, A, D>) -> Self {
        let shape = view.raw_dim();
        let remaining = view.len();
        let mode = if remaining == 0 {
            IterMode::Empty
        } else if view.is_f_contiguous() {
            IterMode::Contiguous { next: 0 }
        } else {
            IterMode::Strided {
                state: StrideState::new(shape.clone(), D::zeros(view.ndim())),
            }
        };

        Self {
            ptr: view.as_ptr(),
            shape,
            strides: view.strides().clone(),
            remaining,
            mode,
            marker: PhantomData,
        }
    }
}

impl<'a, A, D> ElementsMut<'a, A, D>
where
    D: Dimension + Clone,
{
    pub(crate) fn new(view: TensorViewMut<'a, A, D>) -> Self {
        let shape = view.raw_dim();
        let remaining = view.len();
        let mode = if remaining == 0 {
            IterMode::Empty
        } else if view.is_f_contiguous() {
            IterMode::Contiguous { next: 0 }
        } else {
            IterMode::Strided {
                state: StrideState::new(shape.clone(), D::zeros(view.ndim())),
            }
        };

        Self {
            ptr: view.as_mut_ptr(),
            shape,
            strides: view.strides().clone(),
            remaining,
            mode,
            marker: PhantomData,
        }
    }
}

fn logical_offset<D: Dimension>(index: &D, strides: &D) -> isize {
    index
        .slice()
        .iter()
        .zip(strides.slice().iter())
        .map(|(&idx, &stride)| idx as isize * stride)
        .sum()
}

impl<'a, A, D: Dimension> Iterator for Elements<'a, A, D> {
    type Item = &'a A;

    fn next(&mut self) -> Option<Self::Item> {
        if self.remaining == 0 {
            return None;
        }

        let item = match &mut self.mode {
            IterMode::Empty => return None,
            IterMode::Contiguous { next } => {
                let current = *next;
                *next += 1;
                unsafe { &*self.ptr.add(current) }
            }
            IterMode::Strided { state } => {
                let offset = logical_offset(state.index(), &self.strides);
                let item = unsafe { &*self.ptr.offset(offset) };
                state.advance();
                item
            }
        };

        self.remaining -= 1;
        Some(item)
    }

    fn size_hint(&self) -> (usize, Option<usize>) {
        (self.remaining, Some(self.remaining))
    }
}

impl<'a, A, D: Dimension> ExactSizeIterator for Elements<'a, A, D> {}

impl<'a, A, D: Dimension> Iterator for ElementsMut<'a, A, D> {
    type Item = &'a mut A;

    fn next(&mut self) -> Option<Self::Item> {
        if self.remaining == 0 {
            return None;
        }

        let item = match &mut self.mode {
            IterMode::Empty => return None,
            IterMode::Contiguous { next } => {
                let current = *next;
                *next += 1;
                unsafe { &mut *self.ptr.add(current) }
            }
            IterMode::Strided { state } => {
                let offset = logical_offset(state.index(), &self.strides);
                let item = unsafe { &mut *self.ptr.offset(offset) };
                state.advance();
                item
            }
        };

        self.remaining -= 1;
        Some(item)
    }

    fn size_hint(&self) -> (usize, Option<usize>) {
        (self.remaining, Some(self.remaining))
    }
}

impl<'a, A, D: Dimension> ExactSizeIterator for ElementsMut<'a, A, D> {}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::{Elements, ElementsMut};
    use crate::dimension::{Ix0, Ix2};
    use crate::tensor::Tensor;

    #[test]
    fn test_elements_contig() {
        let tensor = Tensor::from_shape_vec(Ix2([2, 3]), vec![0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]).unwrap();
        let values: Vec<i32> = Elements::new(tensor.view()).copied().collect();
        assert_eq!(values, vec![0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_elements_non_contiguous() {
        let tensor = Tensor::from_shape_vec(Ix2([2, 3]), vec![0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]).unwrap();
        let transposed = tensor.t().view();
        let values: Vec<i32> = Elements::new(transposed).copied().collect();
        assert_eq!(values, vec![0, 3, 1, 4, 2, 5]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_elements_empty() {
        let tensor = Tensor::<i32, Ix2>::zeros(Ix2([0, 3]));
        assert_eq!(Elements::new(tensor.view()).count(), 0);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_elements_ix0() {
        let tensor = Tensor::from_shape_vec(Ix0(), vec![7]).unwrap();
        let values: Vec<i32> = Elements::new(tensor.view()).copied().collect();
        assert_eq!(values, vec![7]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_elements_mut_write() {
        let mut tensor = Tensor::from_shape_vec(Ix2([2, 2]), vec![1, 2, 3, 4]).unwrap();
        for value in ElementsMut::new(tensor.view_mut()) {
            *value *= 2;
        }
        assert_eq!(tensor.as_slice().unwrap(), &[2, 4, 6, 8]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_elements_large_tensor_count() {
        let tensor = Tensor::<i32, Ix2>::zeros(Ix2([32, 64]));
        let iter = Elements::new(tensor.view());
        assert_eq!(iter.len(), 2048);
    }
}
